```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(spdep)

# 1. 读取数据
head(bicycle)
# 2. 按社区聚合案件数
bike_neigh <- bicycle %>%
  filter(!is.na(long), !is.na(lat), !is.na(neighborhood)) %>%
  group_by(neighborhood, long, lat) %>%
  summarise(
    incidents = n(),
    avg_cost = mean(bike_cost, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. 转为空间对象，并投影到 UTM，距离单位变成米
bike_sf <- st_as_sf(
  bike_neigh,
  coords = c("long", "lat"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
) %>%
  st_transform(32617)   # Toronto 所在 UTM zone，单位为米

coords <- st_coordinates(bike_sf)

# 4. 构建空间邻居关系：5.6 km 内视为邻居
nb <- dnearneigh(
  coords,
  d1 = 0,
  d2 = 5600
)

# 5. 构建空间权重矩阵
lw <- nb2listw(
  nb,
  style = "W",
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

# 6. 全局 Moran's I 检验
moran_result <- moran.test(
  bike_neigh$incidents,
  lw,
  zero.policy = TRUE
)

print(moran_result)

# 7. 提取 Moran's I 和 p-value
moran_i <- moran_result$estimate["Moran I statistic"]
p_value <- moran_result$p.value

cat("Moran's I =", round(moran_i, 3), "\n")
cat("p-value =", p_value, "\n")
```

```{r}
# 加载包
library(tidyverse)
library(ggmap)
library(viridis)

# 注册 Stadia Maps API key（执行一次即可）
# 不建议把 API key 明文写进作业代码；请先在系统环境变量里设置 STADIA_MAPS_KEY。
if (Sys.getenv("STADIA_MAPS_KEY") != "") {
  register_stadiamaps(key = Sys.getenv("STADIA_MAPS_KEY"))
}

# 2. 清洗数据
bike_clean <- bicycle %>%
  filter(!is.na(long), !is.na(lat), !is.na(neighborhood))

# 3. 设置地图范围
toronto_bbox <- c(
  left   = min(bike_clean$long) - 0.02,
  bottom = min(bike_clean$lat) - 0.02,
  right  = max(bike_clean$long) + 0.02,
  top    = max(bike_clean$lat) + 0.02
)

# 4. 获取地图底图（使用 Stadia Maps）
map_background <- get_stadiamap(
  bbox = toronto_bbox,
  zoom = 11,
  maptype = "stamen_toner_lite"
)

# 5. 绘制热力图
p_heatmap <- ggmap(map_background) +
  stat_bin2d(
    data = bike_clean,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, fill = after_stat(count)),
    bins = 45,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Number of\nIncidents") +
  labs(
    title = "Spatial Distribution of Bike Theft Incidents",
    subtitle = "Each grid cell represents the count of thefts in that area",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, color = "gray35"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "fields", "sf", "sp", "gstat", "viridis"))

library(tidyverse)
library(fields)
library(sf)
library(sp)
library(gstat)
library(viridis)

# 1. 读取并聚合数据
bicycle <- read_csv("four_dataset/bicycle.csv")

bike_neigh <- bicycle %>%
  filter(!is.na(long), !is.na(lat), !is.na(neighborhood)) %>%
  group_by(neighborhood, long, lat) %>%
  summarise(
    incidents = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log_count = log1p(incidents)
  )

# 2. 投影到 UTM，距离单位更合理
bike_sf <- st_as_sf(
  bike_neigh,
  coords = c("long", "lat"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
) %>%
  st_transform(32617)

coords_utm <- st_coordinates(bike_sf)

bike_model <- bike_neigh %>%
  mutate(
    x_km = coords_utm[, 1] / 1000,
    y_km = coords_utm[, 2] / 1000
  )
```

```{r}
Wt_IDW <- function(theta, d) {
  d[d == 0] <- 1e-8
  1 / (d ^ theta)
}

LOOCV_IDW <- function(theta, data) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  errors <- numeric(n)

  coords <- as.matrix(data[, c("x_km", "y_km")])
  dist_mat <- rdist(coords)

  for (i in 1:n) {
    train_y <- data$log_count[-i]
    test_y <- data$log_count[i]

    d <- dist_mat[i, -i]
    w <- Wt_IDW(theta, d)
    w <- w / sum(w)

    pred <- sum(w * train_y)
    errors[i] <- (pred - test_y)^2
  }

  sqrt(mean(errors, na.rm = TRUE))
}

theta_grid <- seq(1, 6, by = 0.5)

idw_results <- tibble(
  theta = theta_grid,
  rmse = map_dbl(theta_grid, ~ LOOCV_IDW(.x, bike_model))
) %>%
  mutate(best = rmse == min(rmse))

best_theta <- idw_results$theta[which.min(idw_results$rmse)]
best_idw_rmse <- min(idw_results$rmse)

p_idw_tuning <- ggplot(idw_results, aes(x = theta, y = rmse)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2C7FB8", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(aes(color = best), size = 3) +
  geom_text(
    data = filter(idw_results, best),
    aes(label = paste0("Best θ = ", theta)),
    vjust = -1,
    color = "red",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "#2C7FB8", "TRUE" = "red"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "LOOCV Parameter Tuning for IDW",
    subtitle = "Prediction target: log(theft_count + 1)",
    x = expression(theta~"(Power Parameter)"),
    y = "LOOCV RMSE"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "gray35"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_idw_tuning
```

```{r}
# Kriging 的 LOOCV RMSE
bike_sp <- bike_model
coordinates(bike_sp) <- ~ x_km + y_km
proj4string(bike_sp) <- CRS("+proj=utm +zone=17 +datum=WGS84 +units=km +no_defs")

v_emp <- variogram(log_count ~ 1, bike_sp)

v_fit <- fit.variogram(
  v_emp,
  model = vgm(
    psill = var(bike_model$log_count) * 0.8,
    model = "Sph",
    range = 10,
    nugget = var(bike_model$log_count) * 0.2
  )
)

kriging_cv <- krige.cv(
  log_count ~ 1,
  bike_sp,
  model = v_fit,
  nfold = nrow(bike_model)
)

kriging_rmse <- sqrt(mean(
  (kriging_cv$observed - kriging_cv$var1.pred)^2,
  na.rm = TRUE
))

kriging_rmse
```

```{r}
#线性回归模型的 LOOCV RMSE
LOOCV_lm_basis <- function(data) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  errors <- numeric(n)

  for (i in 1:n) {
    train <- data[-i, ]
    test <- data[i, ]

    model <- lm(
      log_count ~ x_km + y_km + I(x_km^2) + I(y_km^2) + I(x_km * y_km),
      data = train
    )

    pred <- predict(model, newdata = test)
    errors[i] <- (pred - test$log_count)^2
  }

  sqrt(mean(errors, na.rm = TRUE))
}

lm_rmse <- LOOCV_lm_basis(bike_model)

lm_rmse
```

```{r}
# 均值基线模型的 LOOCV RMSE
LOOCV_mean_baseline <- function(data) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  errors <- numeric(n)

  for (i in 1:n) {
    train_y <- data$log_count[-i]
    test_y <- data$log_count[i]

    pred <- mean(train_y, na.rm = TRUE)
    errors[i] <- (pred - test_y)^2
  }

  sqrt(mean(errors, na.rm = TRUE))
}

baseline_rmse <- LOOCV_mean_baseline(bike_model)

baseline_rmse
```

```{r}
# 1. 读取并聚合数据
bicycle <- read_csv("four_dataset/bicycle.csv")

bike_neigh <- bicycle %>%
  filter(!is.na(long), !is.na(lat), !is.na(neighborhood)) %>%

  summarise(

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

    log_count = log1p(theft_count)
  )

# 2. 投影坐标：用于距离计算
bike_sf <- st_as_sf(
  bike_neigh,
  coords = c("long", "lat"),
  crs = 4326,
```

```{r}
# 3. IDW LOOCV 调参
Wt_IDW <- function(theta, d) {
  d[d == 0] <- 1e-8
  1 / (d ^ theta)
}

LOOCV_IDW <- function(theta, data) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  errors <- numeric(n)

  coords <- as.matrix(data[, c("x_km", "y_km")])
  dist_mat <- rdist(coords)

  for (i in 1:n) {
    train_y <- data$log_count[-i]
    test_y <- data$log_count[i]

    d <- dist_mat[i, -i]
    w <- Wt_IDW(theta, d)
    w <- w / sum(w)

    pred <- sum(w * train_y)
    errors[i] <- (pred - test_y)^2
  }

  sqrt(mean(errors, na.rm = TRUE))
}

theta_grid <- seq(1, 6, by = 0.5)

idw_results <- tibble(
  theta = theta_grid,
  rmse = map_dbl(theta_grid, ~ LOOCV_IDW(.x, bike_model))
) %>%
  mutate(
    best = rmse == min(rmse),
    label = paste0(
      "θ = ", theta,
      "<br>LOOCV RMSE = ", round(rmse, 4)
    )
  )

best_theta <- idw_results$theta[which.min(idw_results$rmse)]
best_idw_rmse <- min(idw_results$rmse)
```

```{r}
coordinates(bike_sp) <- ~ x_km + y_km
proj4string(bike_sp) <- CRS("+proj=utm +zone=17 +datum=WGS84 +units=km +no_defs")

v_emp <- variogram(log_count ~ 1, bike_sp)

v_fit <- fit.variogram(
  v_emp,

    model = "Sph",
    range = 10,
    nugget = var(bike_model$log_count) * 0.2
  )
)

kriging_cv <- krige.cv(
  log_count ~ 1,
  bike_sp,
  model = v_fit,
  nfold = nrow(bike_model)
)

kriging_rmse <- sqrt(mean(
  (kriging_cv$observed - kriging_cv$var1.pred)^2,
  na.rm = TRUE
))
```


```{r}
# 5. Linear Regression with Basis Functions LOOCV
LOOCV_lm_basis <- function(data) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  errors <- numeric(n)

  for (i in 1:n) {
    train <- data[-i, ]
    test <- data[i, ]

    model <- lm(
      log_count ~ x_km + y_km + I(x_km^2) + I(y_km^2) + I(x_km * y_km),
      data = train
    )

    pred <- predict(model, newdata = test)
    errors[i] <- (pred - test$log_count)^2
  }

  sqrt(mean(errors, na.rm = TRUE))
}

lm_rmse <- LOOCV_lm_basis(bike_model)
```


```{r}
# 6. Mean Baseline LOOCV
LOOCV_mean_baseline <- function(data) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  errors <- numeric(n)

  for (i in 1:n) {
    train_y <- data$log_count[-i]
    test_y <- data$log_count[i]

    pred <- mean(train_y, na.rm = TRUE)
    errors[i] <- (pred - test_y)^2
  }

  sqrt(mean(errors, na.rm = TRUE))
}

baseline_rmse <- LOOCV_mean_baseline(bike_model)
```

```{r}
# 8. 构建专业模型对比表格（精简版）
model_table <- tibble(
  Model = c(
    paste0("IDW (θ = ", best_theta, ")"),
    "Ordinary Kriging",
    "Linear Regression",
    "Mean Baseline"
  ),
  `Prediction Target` = rep("log(theft_count + 1)", 4),
  `LOOCV RMSE` = c(
    best_idw_rmse,
    kriging_rmse,
    lm_rmse,
    baseline_rmse
  ),
  `Key Parameters` = c(
    paste0("θ = ", best_theta),
    paste0(
      "Spherical, range = ",
      round(v_fit$range[2], 2),
      " km"
    ),
    "x, y, x², y², xy",
    "Global mean"
  )
) %>%
  arrange(`LOOCV RMSE`) %>%
  mutate(
    Rank = row_number(),
    `LOOCV RMSE` = round(`LOOCV RMSE`, 4)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Rank,
    Model,
    `Prediction Target`,
    `LOOCV RMSE`,
    `Key Parameters`
  )

# 生成交互式 HTML 表格（精简版）
model_table_html <- datatable(
  model_table,
  rownames = FALSE,
  options = list(
    pageLength = 4,
    dom = "t",
    ordering = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(className = "dt-center", targets = c(0, 3))
    )
  ),
  caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
    style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; font-size: 18px;",
    "Model Comparison Table: LOOCV Performance on the Same Prediction Target"
  )
) %>%
  formatStyle(
    "Rank",
    backgroundColor = styleEqual(
      c(1, 2, 3, 4),
      c("#DCFCE7", "#EFF6FF", "#FEF3C7", "#FEE2E2")
    ),
    fontWeight = "bold"
  ) %>%
  formatStyle(
    "LOOCV RMSE",
    fontWeight = "bold",

  )
```

```{r}
# 如未安装，先运行
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "sf", "viridis", "patchwork"))

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(viridis)
library(patchwork)

# =========================
# 1. 读取并聚合数据
# =========================


bike_neigh <- bicycle %>%
  filter(!is.na(long), !is.na(lat), !is.na(neighborhood)) %>%
  group_by(neighborhood, long, lat) %>%
  summarise(
    theft_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log_count = log1p(theft_count)
  )

# 转为 sf，并投影到 UTM，方便距离计算
bike_sf <- st_as_sf(
  bike_neigh,
  coords = c("long", "lat"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
) %>%
  st_transform(32617)

coords_utm <- st_coordinates(bike_sf)

bike_model <- bike_neigh %>%
  mutate(
    x_km = coords_utm[, 1] / 1000,
    y_km = coords_utm[, 2] / 1000
  )

# =========================
# 2. IDW 函数
# =========================

idw_predict <- function(train_coords, train_values, pred_coords, theta = 3) {
  pred <- numeric(nrow(pred_coords))
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pred_coords))) {
    d <- sqrt(
      (train_coords[, 1] - pred_coords[i, 1])^2 +
        (train_coords[, 2] - pred_coords[i, 2])^2
    )
    
    d[d == 0] <- 1e-8
    
    w <- 1 / (d ^ theta)
    w <- w / sum(w)
    
    pred[i] <- sum(w * train_values)
  }
  
  pred
}

# 使用 LOOCV 得到的最佳 theta；如果单独运行本 chunk，则默认用 3
theta_best <- if (exists("best_theta")) best_theta else 3

train_coords <- as.matrix(bike_model[, c("x_km", "y_km")])
train_values <- bike_model$log_count

# =========================
# 3. 生成预测网格
# =========================

grid_utm <- expand.grid(
  x_km = seq(min(bike_model$x_km), max(bike_model$x_km), length.out = 100),
  y_km = seq(min(bike_model$y_km), max(bike_model$y_km), length.out = 80)
)

grid_coords <- as.matrix(grid_utm[, c("x_km", "y_km")])

grid_utm$pred_log_count <- idw_predict(
  train_coords = train_coords,
  train_values = train_values,
  pred_coords = grid_coords,
  theta = theta_best
)

grid_utm$pred_theft_count <- expm1(grid_utm$pred_log_count)

# 转回经纬度只用于检查/弹窗等展示，不用于 geom_raster 绘图。
# 注意 EPSG:32617 的单位是米，所以需要明确创建 x_m/y_m。
grid_sf <- st_as_sf(
  grid_utm %>%
    mutate(
      x_m = x_km * 1000,
      y_m = y_km * 1000
    ),
  coords = c("x_m", "y_m"),
  crs = 32617,
  remove = FALSE
)

grid_ll <- st_transform(grid_sf, 4326)
grid_lonlat <- st_coordinates(grid_ll)

grid_plot <- grid_utm %>%
  mutate(
    long = grid_lonlat[, 1],
    lat = grid_lonlat[, 2]
  )

# =========================
# 4. LOOCV 误差：作为 IDW 不确定性
# =========================

n <- nrow(bike_model)
loocv_pred <- numeric(n)

for (i in seq_len(n)) {
  train_i <- bike_model[-i, ]
  test_i <- bike_model[i, ]
  
  loocv_pred[i] <- idw_predict(
    train_coords = as.matrix(train_i[, c("x_km", "y_km")]),
    train_values = train_i$log_count,
    pred_coords = as.matrix(test_i[, c("x_km", "y_km")]),
    theta = theta_best
  )
}

bike_model <- bike_model %>%
  mutate(
    loocv_error = log_count - loocv_pred,
    squared_error = loocv_error^2,
    abs_error = abs(loocv_error)
  )

idw_rmse <- sqrt(mean(bike_model$squared_error, na.rm = TRUE))

# 将 LOOCV 误差也插值成连续不确定性面
grid_plot$uncertainty <- idw_predict(
  train_coords = train_coords,
  train_values = bike_model$squared_error,
  pred_coords = grid_coords,
  theta = theta_best
)

# =========================
# 5. 绘制 IDW 预测风险面
# =========================

grid_plot <- as.data.frame(grid_plot)

stopifnot(
  is.data.frame(grid_plot),
  all(c("x_km", "y_km", "pred_theft_count", "uncertainty") %in% names(grid_plot))
)

p_idw_risk <- ggplot(
  grid_plot,
  aes(x = x_km, y = y_km, fill = pred_theft_count)
) +
  geom_raster(interpolate = TRUE) +
  geom_point(
    data = bike_model,
    aes(x = x_km, y = y_km),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "white",
    size = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    name = "Predicted\nTheft Count"
  ) +
  coord_fixed(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "IDW Predicted Bike Theft Risk Surface",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Prediction target: log(theft_count + 1), theta = ",
      theta_best,
      ", LOOCV RMSE = ",
      round(idw_rmse, 3)
    ),
    x = "UTM Easting (km)",
    y = "UTM Northing (km)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray35"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_idw_risk


# =========================
# 6. 修复版：绘制 IDW 不确定性图
# =========================

p_idw_uncertainty <- ggplot(
  grid_plot,
  aes(x = x_km, y = y_km, fill = uncertainty)
) +
  geom_raster(interpolate = TRUE) +
  geom_point(
    data = bike_model,
    aes(x = x_km, y = y_km),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "white",
    size = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "cividis",
    name = "LOOCV\nSquared Error"
  ) +
  coord_fixed(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "IDW Empirical Prediction Uncertainty",
    subtitle = "Uncertainty is approximated by interpolated LOOCV squared errors",
    x = "UTM Easting (km)",
    y = "UTM Northing (km)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray35"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_idw_uncertainty


# =========================
# 7. 合并展示并导出
# =========================

p_combined <- p_idw_risk + p_idw_uncertainty +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "IDW Prediction and Empirical Uncertainty",
    subtitle = "Left: predicted theft risk | Right: uncertainty from LOOCV errors"
  )

p_combined

ggsave(
  "idw_predicted_risk_surface.png",
  p_idw_risk,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  "idw_uncertainty_surface.png",
  p_idw_uncertainty,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  "idw_risk_and_uncertainty_combined.png",
  p_combined,
  width = 14,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# =========================
# 4. IDW 平滑版季节分面热力图
# =========================

idw_predict <- function(train_coords, train_values, pred_coords, theta = 3) {
  pred <- numeric(nrow(pred_coords))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pred_coords))) {
    d <- sqrt(
      (train_coords[, 1] - pred_coords[i, 1])^2 +
        (train_coords[, 2] - pred_coords[i, 2])^2
    )

    d[d == 0] <- 1e-8

    w <- 1 / (d ^ theta)
    w <- w / sum(w)

    pred[i] <- sum(w * train_values)
  }

  pred
}

# 先创建季节聚合数据，保证本 chunk 可以独立运行
bike_clean_season <- bicycle %>%
  filter(!is.na(long), !is.na(lat), !is.na(neighborhood), !is.na(date)) %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    quarter_label = paste0("Q", lubridate::quarter(date)),
    quarter_label = factor(quarter_label, levels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"))
  )

quarter_neigh <- bike_clean_season %>%
  group_by(quarter_label, neighborhood, long, lat) %>%
  summarise(
    theft_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 投影到 UTM，避免经纬度距离失真
quarter_sf <- st_as_sf(
  quarter_neigh,
  coords = c("long", "lat"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
) %>%
  st_transform(32617)

coords_utm <- st_coordinates(quarter_sf)

quarter_model <- quarter_neigh %>%
  mutate(
    x_km = coords_utm[, 1] / 1000,
    y_km = coords_utm[, 2] / 1000,
    log_count = log1p(theft_count)
  )

# 创建统一预测网格
grid_utm <- expand.grid(
  x_km = seq(min(quarter_model$x_km), max(quarter_model$x_km), length.out = 80),
  y_km = seq(min(quarter_model$y_km), max(quarter_model$y_km), length.out = 60)
)

grid_coords <- as.matrix(grid_utm[, c("x_km", "y_km")])

# 使用前面 LOOCV 得到的最佳 theta；如果单独运行本 chunk，则默认用 3
theta_best <- if (exists("best_theta")) best_theta else 3

seasonal_predictions <- list()

for (q in levels(quarter_model$quarter_label)) {
  train_q <- quarter_model %>%
    filter(quarter_label == q)

  pred_q <- idw_predict(
    train_coords = as.matrix(train_q[, c("x_km", "y_km")]),
    train_values = train_q$log_count,
    pred_coords = grid_coords,
    theta = theta_best
  )

  seasonal_predictions[[q]] <- grid_utm %>%
    mutate(
      quarter_label = q,
      pred_log_count = pred_q,
      pred_theft_count = expm1(pred_q)
    )
}

seasonal_grid <- bind_rows(seasonal_predictions) %>%
  mutate(
    quarter_label = factor(
      quarter_label,
      levels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4")
    )
  )

p_seasonal_idw <- ggplot(
  seasonal_grid,
  aes(x = x_km, y = y_km, fill = pred_theft_count)
) +
  geom_raster(interpolate = TRUE) +
  geom_point(
    data = quarter_model,
    aes(x = x_km, y = y_km),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "white",
    size = 0.45,
    alpha = 0.55
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    name = "Predicted\nTheft Count"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ quarter_label, nrow = 2) +
  coord_fixed(expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Seasonal Variation of IDW Predicted Theft Risk",
    subtitle = paste0("Q1-Q4 risk surfaces, IDW theta = ", theta_best),
    x = "UTM Easting (km)",
    y = "UTM Northing (km)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "gray35"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_seasonal_idw
```
